title: File:Vista de Valdivia (Puente PdeV, 01).jpg
claims: A waterfront view of Valdivia along the Calle-Calle river: excursion boats and a promenade on the right, white buildings and a church spire behind, a green lawn in the foreground and a cloudy blue sky. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Vista de Valdivia (Puente PdeV, 01).jpg. The route page uses it as Valdivia riverfront context near the finish; it does not show the finish gantry, the exact 2027 finish line or race-day conditions.

The Commons author field reads Draceane; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2019-01-24 23:00; the file page gives a camera or subject position of 39.811650 S, 73.248230 W; the original is 4,272 × 2,848 px; 4,940,138 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 640 px; 172,346 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Draceane, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
